1. (Currently amended) A gas generator comprising: a composition containing an alkali metal chlorate as an oxidizer provided at about 25-75 weight percent, and a carboxylic acid as a fuel provided at about 25-75 weight percent, said percentages stated by weight of the total composition; and a desiccant in operable communication with said composition, wherein said desiccant is selected to provide a mass differential of about -5.0% to 5.0% after heat aging at 107°C for 400 hours.

2. (Currently amended) The gas generator of claim 1 wherein said desiccant is mixed into said composition at about 10-35 weight percent of the total composition and is selected from activated calcium sulfate, silica, zeolite, clay, and calcium oxide.

3. (Previously presented) The gas generator of claim 1 wherein said desiccant is in vapor communication with, but physically separated from, said composition, and said desiccant is provided in amounts resulting in a mass differential of about -5.0 to 5.0% of the composition after heat aging at 107°C for 400 hours.

4. (Previously presented) The gas generator of claim 1 wherein said composition contains an extrusion aid provided at about 0.1-10 weight percent of the total gas generant composition.

5. (Previously presented) The gas generator of claim 4 wherein said extrusion aid is selected from graphite, fumed silica, and mixtures thereof.

6. (Previously presented) The gas generator of claim 1 wherein said alkali metal chlorate is potassium chlorate.

7. (Currently amended) The gas generator of claim 1 wherein said carboxylic acid is selected from DL-tartaric acid, succinic acid, glutamic acid, adipic acid, and mucic acid, and mixtures thereof.

8. (Currently amended) The gas generator of claim 1 wherein said carboxylic acid is DL-tartaric acid and is the predominant fuel component by weight in the composition.

13. (Currently amended) A composition comprising: an alkali metal chlorate as an oxidizer provided at about 25-75 weight percent; a carboxylic acid as a fuel provided at about 25-75 weight percent; and a desiccant selected from activated calcium sulfate, silica, zeolite, clay, and calcium oxide, provided at about 5-35 weight percent, said percentages stated by weight of the total gas generant composition.

14. (Currently amended) The composition of claim 13 wherein said carboxylic acid is selected from DL-tartaric acid, succinic acid, glutamic acid, adipic acid, and mucic acid, and mixtures thereof.

15. (Previously presented) The composition of claim 13 wherein said alkali metal chlorate is potassium chlorate.

16. (Previously presented) The composition of claim 13 wherein said desiccant is selected from activated calcium sulfate, silica, zeolite, clay, and calcium oxide.

17. (Currently amended) The composition of claim 13 wherein said desiccant is zeolite and is provided at about 10-30 weight percent of the total composition.

18. (Currently amended) The composition of claim 13 wherein said desiccant is selected and provided in amounts to provide a mass differential of about -5.0% to 5.0% after heat aging at 107°C for 400 hours, and wherein the composition exhibits thermal stability superior to compositions lacking said desiccant.
